chapter: Orrin Blackstone and the record shop
title: Blackstone's record shop, Parisian Room concerts and radio shows
summary: Steinau learned of the shop in 1948 through a roommate and describes catching Roger Wolfe's jazz show and Parisian Room concerts; Allen describes the shop's layout.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
